name: Lyra Health
one_liner: Enterprise workforce mental health platform serving 20M+ people globally with 3:1 ROI, AI-powered matching, and coverage in 90+ countries.
short_description: Lyra Health is an enterprise mental health benefits platform serving employers with evidence-based care, AI-powered provider matching, and proven 3:1 ROI.
long_description: Lyra Health is the leading enterprise workforce mental health platform, serving more than 20 million people directly through employer contracts and over 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The platform provides comprehensive mental health benefits in 90+ countries with 40 app languages and 119 counselor languages. Lyra's PEPM (per-employee-per-month) pricing model includes access to therapy, coaching, medication management, and digital tools. In October 2025, Lyra launched Lyra Empower—an AI-powered platform combining Connect (real-time analytics for HR), Engage (employee engagement), and Care (clinical delivery). Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra's care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs, delivering an industry-leading 3:1 ROI. Setup costs range from $5,000 to over $50,000 depending on implementation complexity. In 2026, Lyra began rolling out Lyra AI, a clinical-grade conversational AI for mild to moderate challenges like burnout and sleep.
best_for: Mid-to-large employers seeking comprehensive mental health benefits with guaranteed outcomes
Global organizations needing mental health support in 90+ countries
Employers wanting to replace or enhance traditional EAP programs
Companies prioritizing evidence-based treatment and measurement-based care
Organizations with complex mental health needs including substance use and neurodiversity
not_for: Individual clinicians (this is B2B employer platform)
Small businesses under 500 employees (better suited for standard EAP)
Companies wanting simple EAP without analytics

pricing.notes: Per-employee-per-month pricing tailored to organization size and service level. Setup costs range from $5,000 to $50,000+. ROI: every $1 invested saves $3.04 including all session and support service costs.

compliance.notes: Enterprise-grade security with SOC 2, HITRUST, and GDPR compliance for global deployments.
